business_problem: BNP Paribas needed a secure, standardized way for its entities to access and integrate large language models so it could industrialize generative AI use cases across the Group while meeting privacy, security, and cost-control requirements.
solution_summary: BNP Paribas deployed an internal "LLM as a Service" platform to give business units and functions unified access to large language models through a standardized, secure interface. The platform is operated by the Group's IT teams and hosted in BNP Paribas data centers, where specialized GPU infrastructure provides the processing power to run the models inside the bank's own environment. Through this layer, entities can select open-source models or models from Mistral AI that fit their needs and integrate them directly into existing tools and processes. The shared platform serves current use cases such as internal assistants, document generation, and document information retrieval, while enforcing common technical and security standards. BNP Paribas says this common foundation accelerates deployment, supports progressive roll-out across entities, and helps share and limit costs while aligning generative AI usage with business and compliance requirements.

solution_components.name: LLM as a Service
solution_components.role: Provides BNP Paribas entities with a standardized and secure internal interface to access and integrate large language models.

solution_components.name: open-source models
solution_components.role: Supply selectable foundation models that business entities can use for generative AI workloads through the internal platform.

solution_components.name: models from Mistral AI
solution_components.role: Provide partner-supplied language models that BNP Paribas exposes to entities through the platform according to business needs.

data_flow: Group entities access the internal LLM as a Service platform through a standardized secure interface; the platform routes requests to selected open-source or Mistral AI models running on GPU-equipped infrastructure in BNP Paribas data centers, and outputs are integrated back into internal tools and business processes for assistants, document generation, and document retrieval use cases.
business_outcome: The platform gives BNP Paribas a common, secure foundation for scaling generative AI, accelerating deployment of new projects, improving integration of AI into existing processes, and applying shared technical and security standards across entities.
architecture_clues: Hosted in BNP Paribas data centers rather than external cloud infrastructure.
Uses specialized GPU computing capabilities to execute language models at scale.
Operated by the Group's IT teams as shared infrastructure.
Initial test phase was deployed across entities including Hello bank! and the Group's general inspection.
Progressive roll-out is designed to account for local specificities while maintaining common security and compliance controls.
